project_type: Node.js/Express server-side rendered app with Handlebars (.xian = hbs templates), Firebase Firestore backend
build_system: No build step. Run with: node index.js (prod) or nodemon index.js (dev). No compilation needed.
test_framework: None defined in package.json. Verification = start server and manual smoke test, OR node --check <file> for syntax.
verification_instructions: 1. Run: node --check <changed file> to verify no syntax errors. 2. Start server with: node index.js and hit the new routes. 3. Check browser console and server stdout for errors.
environment_constraints: Firebase credentials in process.env or hardcoded fallback. Windows workspace. .xian files are Handlebars templates processed by hbs. Template partials: {{> head }}, {{> navbar }}, {{> sidebar }}, {{> footer }}.
contribution_requirements: Use ESM imports (import/export). Match existing code style in controllers (async/await, try/catch, req.flash for errors, res.render or res.redirect). All routes go in routes/index.js. Firebase accessed via db from models/firebaseConfig.js using firebase/firestore functions (collection, getDocs, getDoc, doc, etc.).
key_patterns: Controllers export named async functions. Routes use requireAuth and requireRole middleware from middleware/auth.js. Views use Handlebars with partials. The CRITERIA_COLORS array and applyTieBreaking() function in scoringController.js are shared across scoring functions. Existing JSON endpoint pattern: getScoringProgress() at /events/:eventId/scoring-progress returns res.json(). Existing scoring computation is repeated verbatim across resultsPage, displayBoard, publicResults, exportResults — extract same pattern for new scoresJson endpoint. DOM manipulation uses document.createElement (not innerHTML) to avoid XSS, as seen in the judgeProgressList updater in results.xian.
directory_structure: Root: index.js (Express entry), routes/index.js (all routes), controllers/*.js (named exports), models/firebaseConfig.js (db/auth), middleware/auth.js (requireAuth, requireRole, injectUser), views/**/*.xian (Handlebars templates), public/ (static assets). No views/partials/footer.xian needed — {{> footer }} already exists.
